patches.value: Nat-indexed sequence of subsets of ℝⁿ covering E, with finite diameter bounds

For each j, the zero infimum of the M008 scale content (M003 gives H^q(E)=0) and the nonempty admissible class (from compactness H002) provide an r_j-cover of E with q-cost <γ_j. Replace every nonempty zero-diameter member by a ball of diameter ≤r_j, assigning the k-th such replacement q-cost <γ_j2^(−k−1). The resulting Nat-indexed cover in ℝⁿ still covers E, has all nonempty diameters positive and at most r_j, and total q-cost <2γ_j.

For every positive real exponent a and positive real scale δ, define C_a(A,δ) as the ENNReal infimum of ∑'_{i:ℕ} ediam(U_i)^a over all Nat-indexed sequences of subsets U_i of the ambient metric space with A⊆⋃_iU_i and ediam(U_i)≤ENNReal.ofReal(δ) for every i. The exponent is the real coercion used in M008. Empty and zero-diameter members are allowed and cost zero because a>0. Finite covers are represented by appending empty members. This is exactly the scale infimum in M008.
